parameters.content:
## 🎫 Jira Zombie Ticket Auto-Resolver

Runs on a schedule to find Jira issues that have sat untouched for 7+ days, then automatically classifies each one's state and takes the right next action — closing resolved issues, nudging stalled ones with a reminder, or trying to solve unanswered ones from your knowledge base.

**Perfect for:** Support/IT teams running Jira Service Management who want stale tickets triaged automatically instead of piling up in the backlog.

---

## How it works

1. **Schedule Trigger** — Kicks off the workflow on a recurring interval.
2. **Get List of Unresolved Long Lived Issues** — Queries Jira for issues in "To Do" or "In Progress" created 7+ days ago.
3. **Execute Workflow** — Runs the rest of the logic once per issue found, calling this same workflow recursively.
4. **Execute Workflow Trigger** — Entry point for each individual issue run.
5. **Get Issue Metadata** — Pulls the issue's key, title, URL, date, reporter, and description into a clean object.
6. **Get Issue Comments** — Fetches every comment on the issue from Jira.
7. **Join Comments** — Aggregates all comment items into a single array.
8. **Simplify Thread For AI** — Flattens the comment thread and issue metadata into plain text the AI models can read.
9. **Classify Current Issue State** — AI classifier (OpenAI Chat Model) sorts the issue into "resolved," "pending more information," or "still waiting."
10. **Customer Satisfaction Agent** *(resolved path)* — AI sentiment analysis (OpenAI Chat Model4) judges whether the thread ended on a positive, neutral, or negative note.
11. **Ask For Feedback Message** — Posts a thank-you/review-request comment for positively resolved issues, then closes them.
12. **Add Autoclose Message** — Posts a neutral autoclose comment for neutrally resolved issues, then closes them.
13. **Report Unhappy Resolution** — Alerts the Slack channel when a "resolved" issue actually has a negative sentiment score, without closing it.
14. **Close Issue** — Marks the issue as Done after a feedback or autoclose message is posted.
15. **Last Message is Not Bot** *(still waiting path)* — Checks the last comment isn't itself an automated message before nagging again.
16. **Issue Reminder Agent** — AI (OpenAI Chat Model3) writes a short reminder summarizing what's still pending.
17. **Send Reminder** — Posts that reminder as a new comment on the issue.
18. **KnowledgeBase Agent** *(pending information path)* — AI agent (OpenAI Chat Model1) searches for an answer using the **Find Simlar Issues** and **Query KnowledgeBase** tools, returning structured output via the **Structured Output Parser**.
19. **Solution Found?** — Branches on whether the agent found a usable answer.
20. **Reply to Issue** — Posts the AI's answer as a comment when a solution is found.
21. **Notify Slack Channel** *(optional path)* — Alerts the team in Slack when no knowledgebase answer was found; the ticket still gets closed.
22. **Close Issue2** — Marks the issue as Done after the KB reply (or Slack notification) is posted.

---

## Setup (~15 min)

1. **Jira Software Cloud** — Connect your credentials in every Jira node (*Get List of Unresolved Long Lived Issues*, *Get Issue Metadata*, *Get Issue Comments*, *Close Issue*, *Close Issue2*, *Send Reminder*, *Reply to Issue*, *Ask For Feedback Message*, *Add Autoclose Message*, *Find Simlar Issues*).
2. **OpenAI API** — Add your API key in all four model nodes (*OpenAI Chat Model*, *OpenAI Chat Model1*, *OpenAI Chat Model3*, *OpenAI Chat Model4*).
3. **Notion** — Connect your credentials in *Query KnowledgeBase* and confirm it points at your support knowledgebase.
4. **Slack** — Connect your credentials in *Notify Slack Channel* and *Report Unhappy Resolution*, and set the target channel.
5. **JQL filter** — Adjust the `created <= -7d` and status filter in *Get List of Unresolved Long Lived Issues* to match your team's SLA.
6. **Status ID** — Confirm the "Done" status ID (`31`) in *Close Issue* and *Close Issue2* matches your Jira workflow.
> This workflow closes tickets automatically. Test it on a non-production project first, and update the placeholder review link in *Ask For Feedback Message* before publishing.

## 1️⃣ Trigger & Intake

The **Schedule Trigger** kicks off a periodic scan, and **Get List of Unresolved Long Lived Issues** pulls every Jira ticket that's been open 7+ days. **Execute Workflow** loops through them one at a time via **Execute Workflow Trigger**, and **Get Issue Metadata**, **Get Issue Comments**, and **Join Comments** collect the issue's details and full comment history. **Simplify Thread For AI** flattens it all into plain text, which **Classify Current Issue State** then sorts into resolved, pending information, or still waiting.

## 2️⃣ Resolved Ticket Handling

When a ticket is classified as resolved, the **Customer Satisfaction Agent** scores the sentiment of the closing exchange. A positive result triggers **Ask For Feedback Message**, a neutral one triggers **Add Autoclose Message**, and both paths finish at **Close Issue**. If the sentiment comes back negative despite being marked resolved, **Report Unhappy Resolution** flags it to Slack instead of closing it automatically.

## 3️⃣ Stalled Ticket Reminders

For tickets still waiting on a response, **Last Message is Not Bot** confirms the thread hasn't already been nudged automatically. The **Issue Reminder Agent** then writes a short, context-aware reminder summarizing what's pending, and **Send Reminder** posts it back to the issue as a comment.

## 4️⃣ Knowledge Base Resolution

For tickets pending more information, the **KnowledgeBase Agent** searches for an answer using the **Find Simlar Issues** and **Query KnowledgeBase** tools, returning a structured result via the **Structured Output Parser**. **Solution Found?** branches the outcome: a match triggers **Reply to Issue** and **Close Issue2**, while no match routes through **Notify Slack Channel** before still closing the ticket.
